root_cause: A manual authority dispatch on current protected main 03156e2b had only a skipped Supabase Preview check pointing at /branches because that commit did not change Supabase runtime. The authority filtered correctly for the production /project check, but then waited for a check that could never appear even though provider source was already byte-identical to current main.
prevention_rule: Manual/current-main Edge authority must accept only either an exact-SHA successful production check or a bounded recent successful Supabase production deployment anchor that is an ancestor and has zero diff versus current main across supabase/config.toml and every selected function tree. Provider byte parity via --use-api remains mandatory.
